description: MCP server exposing LS증권 OpenAPI (REST) as tools. Read-only Korean stock market data and analysis via natural language.
releaseNotes: v0.5.0: Adds a local-only portfolio module (24 new tools, 13 → 37 total) — multi-account holdings with set/buy/sell semantics and weighted-average cost basis on incremental buys, corporate actions (split/reverse_split/bonus) applied across every account holding the symbol by default, watchlists with group rename, watched sectors via t1531 with 60s cache, structured error envelopes (RequiresAccount / AmbiguousAccount / AccountNotFound / RequiresConfirmation / InsufficientQuantity / ValidationError) that carry candidate accounts so the model can recover automatically, and a two-step cascade confirmation on account removal with id ASC default succession. Symbol validation relaxed to 6-character alphanumeric (uppercased) so ETF codes like 0117V0 are accepted. Local SQLite store at %LOCALAPPDATA%\RedoxNet\LsOpenApi\portfolio.db (override via LSOPENAPI_DB_PATH). Tools removed: ls_account_set, ls_holdings_add, ls_holdings_update. See https://github.com/redoxnet/mcp-lsopenapi/blob/main/RELEASENOTES.Mcp.md for full notes.
